folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B262
folds.body:
Full synthesis reviewed through its reciprocal-recovery ending: all original September/October sections, five expansion principles, portability/access/interruption/outcome tables, RC1–5 and BT1–10. Preserve its original proposals and the explicitly endorsed October 2 five-principle expansion guidance. That endorsement does not adopt every adjacent numeric example, path, origin, replay policy, save restriction or stage gate. The later October 15 recovery, CA and reciprocal-return answers already qualify earlier fixed run-end and anchor-exhaustion proposals.

Current direction is owned by [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md#current-focus), the [digest](VISION_DIGEST.md) and [direction summary](DIRECTION_SUMMARY.md#standing-boundaries). In particular, every one-realm/one-prestige requirement in this synthesis is superseded by [the October 24 instruction](USER_VISION.md#first-milestone-and-scope-check-2026-10-24). Its base-first, mentor-expedition, finished-elder-before-return, repeated-prototype and home-world expansion sequences are historical proposals, not a present prerequisite for Klein, Harry, a selected shared seam or ordinary world entry. The recommendation to prefer a side role alongside canon is likewise a retained option, not a reversal of the developer lead-life route and later ordinary low-spoiler starts. Frontier/Mistglass depth stays with the current book-world/test-bed direction. The named Jade Hollow archive and older delivered local contract are dated records, not new deletion or reactivation work.

Keep the actual useful distinctions: body versus world/life/timeline, technology versus institutional capability, custody versus recognition, a learned procedure versus its source/fuel/control, and a physical passage versus projection or rebirth. One retained self and current-world methods do not require a particular external anchor cosmology. The optional vague awakening is not a source-qualified backstory or a license to erase a named protagonist's known history. True death, fainting, survival, reset and ordinary reload remain different operations. RC5 explicitly prevents ordinary player reload from being mistaken for lore-aware time travel.

Several early repeat/replay guards are stronger than the later authority. The dated “no uncapped mastery,” no reusable extraction rewards, unrepeatable local unique goods, no RNG reroll and no spendable replay outputs are bounded prototype proposals. Apply actual world/means and settlement identity: accidental repayment of one committed operation is an integrity bug, while a new attempt, regenerated stock, copied object or genuinely repeatable power can legitimately pay (AD22, AD38). SLR5/SLR34 preserve continuing fluency gains where the mechanism supplies them. No later world is required to use a temporary scenario kit, one outcome entitlement or global reward replacement. The ordinary save/reload default and optional harsh policies remain distinct from fictional repeat restrictions.

The five-principle guidance stays useful without forced parity: a dominant means may solve all fitting obstacles, and natural strengths need not be countered merely to make two builds equal. A known access route, random origin and specific start follow current WER mechanisms rather than the early two-origin prototype. Illustrative 60/30/10 treatment outcomes, chapter budgets, time-to-choice measures, rate caps and full-path review are unselected values, not lore facts or universal release gates. Long play is welcome under AD52; shorter repeated labor and bounded delivery do not set a short campaign target.

BT1–10 already separate unprocessed eligible time, forward simulated duration, spending throughput, activity yield and conversion powers. Preserve that separation and the unresolved restored-history balance policy; no bank store, automatic spending or time-free resource generation was implemented by an answer or by this review. Information-limited forecasts, remembered event claims and return recaps do not expose hidden probability modifiers, event truth or unattended losses. Source synopsis comparisons remain synopsis-level evidence, and the old 54-test/readiness/native-function statements remain dated; no linked source pages, current gameplay or tests were rerun. The historical cheat-chat assignment grants no current file reservation, dispatch or new runtime authority.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B262
folds.body:
Full palette reviewed: K1–31, E1–6, T1–10, I1–22, both fiction tables and both smallest-proof queues. Preserve these as creative possibilities with proposed hooks. The mathematical/physical analogies and franchise-specific details are not source-qualified by this pass; the fiction list itself says from memory. A local formalization needs its actual assumptions and source before being called a theorem-derived world law. No listed book is thereby selected for acquisition, reading or implementation.

K1/E2's ordinal-like tuple is a possible finite representation, not a general implementation of all ordinals, cardinalities or infinities. A transition from finite floors to an omega-labelled floor needs an authored route; incrementing finite integers does not reach it. K2's renumbering must preserve occupant/item/obligation identity and the old-address meaning, rather than changing every saved identity when one room is inserted. Lazy K11/K12 generation needs stable allocation and an authorized resolution boundary: a diagnostic read, hidden-row count or mount must not silently consume a world draw or make an observer discover a fact. Changing canonical truth and changing what an observer knows remain separate mechanisms (AD6–AD9, AR8).

K5's one sealed self-blind spot is a fiction option, not a consequence proved for every System by the named theorem. K6/E5's exhausted search budget establishes “not resolved within this budget,” not impossibility, undecidability or a proof that the program never halts. Reuse/resume only if the query, state, rules and actual search input still fit; do not treat a timeout as a reliable prophecy. K15/I16 must keep zero probability, impossibility and tiny positive weight separate. A separate tiny-mass table is an authored rare-event distribution, not a representation of a zero-probability event; a probability-editing mechanism may also deliberately force a result if its world supports that means (AD5, AD38).

K3/K17/K29 suggest conservation and entropy models; they do not establish a universal falling stock, cost, ban on free outcomes or automatic watcher for every world. K9's continuity score cannot by itself reveal identity to NPCs without actual evidence or perception; it also need not decide the player's metaphysical identity. K10's seeded simulation is a computational property, not proof that only the player can cause divergence in the fiction. K12 observation, K18 dimensions and K25's unmeasurable tag similarly need actual local mechanisms; the label alone grants no physical interaction or duplication. K14/I13's shorter rule description and perfect recall do not demonstrate lost detail, inability to abstract or guaranteed competence.

K31's proposed “same result in any order” is stronger than ordinary chunked catch-up. Interacting activities, resource contention, hazards and causal dependencies can make reordering matter. A selected clock/transaction owner should specify equivalent segmentations and preserve causal order; serial versus batched equality for a defined input does not prove arbitrary permutation equivalence. External absence, local time, body aging and stopped-time behavior remain separately owned. Runtime compute limits protect responsiveness; they do not alone cap what the fictional ability can do, which can use a closed-form, abstraction or deferred resolution.

T1–10 are useful consequence prompts on the selected meaningful boundaries, not ten new mandatory tests for every numeric ability. Their sample assumptions about market collapse, automatic social attention, shared clone fatigue, signatures and counters need actual suppliers and local reasons. I3's movable ability data does not imply all powers are transferable, and I4's supernatural tag cannot replace a negation mechanism's actual target semantics. Preserve strong copying, growth, wishes and free outcomes where supported. The E1 warning about non-finite values identifies a serialization hazard, not a reproduced current save defect or authority to clamp every domain silently. A selected numeric domain needs validation/representation and compatibility at its real owner; no save-wide migration, number library, oracle, test or source-reading wave was selected. Existing adaptation and ability work is separately scoped in [ABILITY_RULES](ABILITY_RULES.md#content-reconciliation-b256).
